newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Midopa to sell construction division.
newsitem.headline: Midopa to sell construction division.

text.p: South Korea's Midopa Department Store Co said on Thursday it would sell its loss-making construction division to Midopa Industrial Development Co as part of a self-rescue plan.
A Midopa Department statement said Midopa Industrial had recently been set up jointly between its affiliate Midopa Development Co and two other domestic firms.
The statement said all assets of Midopa Department's construction division would be sold to Midopa Industrial for about 42.37 billion won.
But the sale price would be finalised later, it said.
Midopa Department's construction division posted a net loss of 1.2 billion won in the year to June 30, while the company posted a net profit of 3.14 billion, the statement said.
Midopa Department Store is a core unit of the Dainong Group, which was tapped for bail-out in May by creditor banks.
The Dainong Group, struggling under 1.7 trillion won of debt, has said it would raise 820 billion won by the end of June 1998 by selling affiliates and real estate.
